title: Hotbar Shuffle Chaos
description: Every 1 minutes, your hotbar is randomly shuffled, creating chaotic and unpredictable gameplay.
body:
# Hotbar Shuffle Chaos

Hotbar Shuffle Chaos is a Minecraft Forge mod that adds chaotic gameplay by periodically shuffling your hotbar.

Every 1 minutes, the items in your hotbar are randomly rearranged. Players must constantly adapt to changing item positions, making survival and general gameplay unpredictable and challenging.

The mod is designed for chaotic gameplay, challenge runs, and players who enjoy unpredictable mechanics.

## Features
- Hotbar shuffles automatically every 1 minutes
- Fully random item rearrangement
- Works in both survival and creative modes
- Designed for chaos-based gameplay and challenge runs
## Note

This mod intentionally disrupts normal gameplay and is not intended for balance or convenience.
